text: Abraham had pleaded for Sodom. In Genesis 22 the three days of travel have the effect of a suspended sentence; outwardly nothing happens, while in significance everything happens. Faith, in this story, takes the form of a structured relation or arrangement, in which obedience stands beside horror, and neither is permitted to prevail over the other. The servants, the wood, the knife, and the fire are named with care; the instruments of the act are present before the act itself happens.
